text:
maria_cs: Heads-up from today's onboarding batch — three customers brought up closely related asks. dropping them here so we can quickly decide what to spike.

maria_cs: Short list: (A) clearer per-route billing breakdown (customers: Acme, NorthBay) (B) route-level opt-out for continuous batching (low-latency chat use-cases) (C) ability to pin embedding model per integration.

zoe_csm: Acme mentioned renewal in ~45 days and said cost unpredictability is the main blocker. they sent a billing excerpt but asked for an in-console explanation per-route.

sam_pm: Do we have an existing ticket for cost-per-route? if not, we should capture impact and owners now.

csbot: @sam_pm created ticket CS-1435: "Per-route billing clarity + batching opt-out" applied label: renewal-risk.

devin_sre: From infra side, per-route cost attribution is mostly a UI/analytics workstream — we already emit tokens & flank metrics per request but need an aggregation + join to invoice mapping. ETA: 1.5 sprints for a minimal dashboard and export.

anya_eng: Runtime note: continuous batching is the default because it improves throughput, but I can add a quick config check to skip batching for routes that opt-out. should be a small change (one sprint) but we'll need a safe rollout.

zoe_csm: GreenBridge reported quality drop when we switched to the 4-bit quantized variant — they want to pin a non-quantized embedding model for a specific route. is that supported today?

anya_eng: Not yet. We have model variants, but route-level pinning requires control-plane + policy check. Medium effort (2-3 sprints) if we include rollout hooks and migration path.

maria_cs: Prioritization suggestion from CS: 1) batching opt-out (fast win, may reduce renewal risk) 2) per-route billing visibility (mid) 3) embedding pin per route (longer).

sam_pm: agree. Also request we add a small experiment: flag the top 5 requests that are <20 tokens and show latency vs batched latency in the dashboard. that would help quantify impact for Acme.

devin_sre: I can push a trace export for acme-org last 14 days — will include tokens, batching flag, latency ms, and host. dropping a link when ready.

zoe_csm: please also collect a sample of 200 short prompts from Acme so we can run quality diffs across quantized vs full models.

csbot: @maria_cs attached logs:
```
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] org=acme req=lkj34 latency_ms=95 tokens=7 batching=on
[2026-03-24T09:12:02Z] org=acme req=lkj35 latency_ms=405 tokens=6 batching=on
[2026-03-24T09:12:05Z] org=acme req=lkj36 latency_ms=88 tokens=3 batching=off
```

anya_eng: Thanks, those patterns are useful. I'll scope the runtime flag for opt-out and propose default behavior = batching enabled unless opt-out is explicit per route.

sam_pm: Next steps: dev spike for opt-out (anya), trace export (devin), prompt sample + eval (zoe + maria), product note for roadmap timing (sam). I'll assign owners in CS-1435.

maria_cs: I'll surface this at tomorrow GTM sync and ask renewals to join the Acme call if we can get the opt-out into a fast-fix.

zoe_csm: also adding customer quote to the ticket: "We keep seeing sporadic high charges and can't map them to behavior".

maria_cs: Great thread. I'll post the meeting notes after the sync. :sparkles:
